candidates.summary: Faction/reputation access to special gear as a setting-scoped acquisition/reward profile; item definitions and values are unresolved.
Carnival may offer rare loot as a campaign reward; no loot table, item identity, rarity conversion, rate or value is approved.
Scavenge training, starter gear and relic-cleaner/repair hooks as Dionasia profession content; no universal scavenge bonus or relic salvage rule.
Salvager/Artifact Scavenger profession concepts and valuable-salvage identification; numerical perks, yields and compatibility remain unapproved.
Owner explicitly wants Helldiver faction perks to include weapons/equipment/trans-portal aid. Specific faction gear, ranks and Relic Salvage Rights remain assistant-generated proposals.
Reality-scoped Loot Rule may choose drops, chests, normal harvesting or generated rewards, with inventory/equipment/corpse-recovery concepts; no universal game-loot semantics.
Owner-established Underworks provides recoverable-location context; heritage-font recovery, bloom recycling and repair specifics remain assistant proposals pending owning-domain definitions.
Peripheral scrap hives are a possible setting-scoped scavenge-zone cue only; contents, concentration, depletion, legality and yields are not inferred.

boundaries.detail: Blood Tree harvest, creature products, bones/hide/meat and other biological outputs remain ICF-07/ICF authority; LSS does not infer object salvage yields from them.
Natural-poison harvesting mentioned in assistant profession text is biological/ingredient authority, not LSS loot or salvage.
Natural-resource harvesting remains ICF/World/profession context unless an authored recoverable object exists; LSS cannot generate biological/material yields by inference.
Weapons, equipment, relics and recovered items become live possessions only through D17/owner-domain Asset and transfer receipts; source prose does not create inventory state.
Reality-specific drops/chests/rewards cannot become a universal LSS drop table or global defeat-to-loot rule.
Corpse recovery is an assistant-generated game-reality option; death/revival authority and D17 ownership rules must both be satisfied before equipment recovery can operate.
A transported memory artifact is narrative/World content; existence or transport does not imply it is lootable, salvageable or decomposable.
The Goblifex is setting lore; artifact mention alone does not authorize acquisition, theft, salvage or component decomposition.
A world described as a hotspot for treasure hunters is a World/adventure hook, not enough evidence to define recoverables, rarity, tables or values.
A narrative objective to recover a heritage font does not bypass permissions, provenance, ownership transfer or source-state rules.
The phrase scrap hives cannot be expanded into authored salvage contents, concentrations, values or yields without setting/content approval.
Custom spells/story rewrites proposed alongside rare loot are supernatural/narrative rewards and must route to RSR-07/WCI rather than LSS inventing them as Assets.
